gateDisposition.summary: Mounted volume metadata was captured. Required remote capacity, source growth, escrow, eligibility, and restore evidence was not gathered; this is not an R0.09 gate verdict.

buildPlan.summary: R0.09 measures primary/archive and independent external/B2 capacity, policy eligibility, escrow, capacity ceiling/lifecycle and growth; it requires a harmless restore probe and says an independent destination is not another internal directory. Dependencies are R0.02 and R0.05. No purchase or upgrade is assumed.

ops.summary: Targets are two independent encrypted restic repositories when both pass capacity/restore gates: an approved existing external volume selected by UUID and private B2 under the fixed host prefix. Internal snapshots do not count as disaster coverage. Ops requires distinct recovery material stored outside this Mac, refuses to create the external repository path on the internal disk, forbids automatic formatting/repurposing, and records missing/blocked destinations without purchase or deployed-coverage claims.

objectives.initialDisasterRecoveryTarget: at most 4 hours for datasets up to 100 GB, subject to measured hardware and bandwidth

ops.backendSelection: Ops §10 names restic's native B2 backend. R0-research separately recommends the B2 S3-compatible API and says that conflicts with Ops, so the backend decision remains a source-level unresolved discrepancy.

contracts.summary: Ops owns backup_set, backup_destination, and restore_drill in state/ops/ops.db. This ownership row does not independently establish destination eligibility or capacity.

lifeStore.summary: R0 must measure actual volumes and independent destinations, account caps/credentials, throughput, repository size, permitted-source policy, dumps, version overhead, staging peaks, prune scratch and restore workspace; forecast no-spend headroom and keep missing off-machine capacity incomplete. AT-lifestore-63 requires dated actual destination headroom and a no-spend forecast.

sources.summary: Sources supplies projected growth, pauses noncritical capture with visible gaps, and does not delete retained data when capacity is unavailable. Ops refuses staging at the configured floor and reuses sealed partial sets. Unproved off-site capacity is unavailable.
